comments.body:
This PR is not something we're going to accept. The tests from this PR are needless AI changes and not acceptable additions.

Adding a field for thought tokens is a change we're considering for the future, but until we do the total token count needs to match the prompt and completion token total.

If you'd like to see traction on that, please open a feature request either on this issue or through our support team.
